papers.title: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models such as GR00T control robots through an action head: a diffusion transformer that turns noise into a chunk of actions in a few flow-matching steps. Every step re-reads all of the head's weights from DRAM but applies each weight to only about fifty tokens. Inference is therefore memory-bound, and its latency and energy are largely determined by the total number of transferred weight bits. We show that later flow steps attenuate the quantization errors of earlier steps, so the weight precision of an action head should rise over the steps. With plain per-channel rounding and without calibration or training, widths rising over the steps from 2 to 4 bits preserve the closed-loop success of robot policies. These widths transfer 25% fewer bits than 4-bit weights at every step. However, we show that on Jetson AGX Thor, current GPU kernels cannot exploit this per-step precision due to fixed overheads. We therefore present a programmable accelerator whose latency and energy both scale with the transferred weight bits. It decodes entropy-coded weights for bit-serial sub-arrays at the DRAM rate. Because the width changes per step, a run-time allocator divides these sub-arrays between the linear layers and the attention to balance their workloads. The same sub-arrays are thus capable of running action heads of different families and sizes, as well as a vision-language model. On the DRAM side, a requantizer and an entropy encoder at each bank let one stored 8-bit copy replace the copies of all widths. Simulated with LPDDR5X timing, our RTL implementation runs the GR00T N1.6 action head in 8.02 ms per inference with 2, 3, 3 and 4 bits in its four flow steps. With a copy per width and 50% of Thor's memory bandwidth, the accelerator runs this schedule 1.7x faster than Thor in NVFP4, at 9.1x less energy and equal closed-loop success.

digest.summaryZh: 该工作利用后续 flow 步骤会衰减早期量化误差的性质，让 VLA 动作头权重精度逐步上升，并以位串行子阵列、熵解码和运行时资源分配把位数减少转化为延迟与能耗收益。硬件结果来自 RTL 与 DRAM 模拟，核心是低比特算法与数据通路协同。
digest.motivationZh: VLA 扩散动作头每个 flow 步骤都重新从 DRAM 读权重，但权重仅用于较少 token，因而权重搬运主导延迟和能耗。 统一精度没有利用不同步骤的误差敏感性；现有 GPU 内核的固定开销又使低于4比特的流量减少难以等比例转为加速。 要在机器人闭环控制中降低动作头开销，必须同时保证任务成功率，并让计算、注意力和非线性处理跟得上可变精度权重流。 高度契合低比特量化、AI 推理芯片计算核心与存储数据通路协同，值得优先深读。
digest.methodZh: 以逐步增精度的权重日程减少传输比特，配套可编程位串行阵列，让不同步骤的运算时间随权重位数变化。 按通道直接舍入，无需校准或训练；较早步骤采用更低位宽，后续步骤采用较高位宽。 DRAM权重流经过FIFO和并行Huffman解码后输入位串行子阵列，激活与当前层KV驻留片上。 运行时在投影计算与注意力之间分配相同子阵列，并流水融合归一化、激活舍入等操作。 可选 bank 侧重量化与熵编码，从一份8比特副本生成所需精度流；乘加仍在加速器执行。 Chisel RTL 经 Verilator 仿真，Ramulator 2 模型化 LPDDR5X；逻辑综合采用 TSMC 7nm。DRAM侧逻辑仅重量化与编码，不能将其描述为存内乘加。 联合步骤误差衰减、精度日程、熵编码与可分配位串行计算核心，使算法位数节省能在硬件上兑现。
digest.experimentsZh: GR00T N1.6等策略在模拟机器人闭环中评估；硬件采用RTL和LPDDR5X时序模拟，并与Jetson AGX Thor比较。 包括发布模型、统一4比特权重以及Thor上的NVFP4动作头；正文还比较其他策略加速器，部分仅有理论下界。 GR00T N1.6采用[2,3,3,4]时，相对统一4比特少传25%权重比特；RTL推理为8.02ms。在带宽为Thor一半且每精度存一份副本的配置下，论文报告相对Thor NVFP4快1.7倍、能耗为其1/9.1，保持闭环成功标准。 非流片实测，能耗与时序依赖综合及DRAM模型；8.02ms针对动作头而非整套机器人端到端。单8比特副本的DRAM侧重量化是另一配置，不能混同上述多副本比较；成功保持按论文统计容差判断。

papers.title: Mechanistic Critics for Sample-Efficient NPU Design-Space Exploration
papers.abstract: NPU design-space exploration for LLM inference mainly relies on an expensive simulator that often returns only scalar feedback such as latency and power. Such feedback can rank evaluated configurations, but gives little information for deciding why a configuration is slow or which architecture parameter should be changed next. This limitation is especially severe because prefill and decode workloads can be limited by different resources, including compute throughput and HBM bandwidth. We propose CriticNPU, a sample-efficient DSE framework built around an online-calibrated mechanistic critic for NPU architecture design. The critic uses explicit hardware limits to evaluate NPU configurations: before simulation, it estimates whether a proposed configuration is likely to improve over the current best and filters weak candidates; after simulation, it aggregates operator-level runtimes into prefill/decode bottleneck summaries and predicts the effect of candidate parameter changes. We instantiate the critic with a Roofline-style model that derives compute and memory limits from architecture parameters and calibrates per-operator-type effective limits using simulator observations. And CriticNPU combines this critic with a workload extractor and an architecture planner to propose configurations. Across six LLM workloads and 16 deployment configurations per model, CriticNPU achieves best-or-tied-best latency in 74% of prefill and 87.5% of decode settings while using roughly half the simulator calls of competitive DSE baselines. We conduct extensive ablation studies and detailed analyses to validate the effectiveness of our method from multiple perspectives. Our code is available at https://github.com/bruno686/CriticNPU.

digest.summaryZh: CriticNPU 将在线校准的 Roofline 机理模型放入 NPU 设计空间探索：仿真前筛除弱候选，仿真后把算子时间归纳为 prefill/decode 瓶颈，并预测参数变化的影响。它减少的是搜索中的模拟器调用，结果基于 NeuSIM 分析模型，不能解读为实芯片加速。
digest.motivationZh: NPU设计探索需要昂贵的配置评估，单一延迟或功耗评分只能排序，难以解释计算、HBM或互连中哪个资源限制性能。 Prefill和decode的瓶颈不同，盲目增加阵列或带宽未必有效；黑盒及LLM候选搜索缺少可随观测修正的结构化反馈。 把算子需求与硬件上限联系起来，可减少无效配置评估，并给计算核心规模和内存资源配置提供可解释依据。 直接关联LLM推理NPU架构、矩阵阵列/向量资源与内存带宽权衡，可辅助构建可复现的架构探索流程。
digest.methodZh: 以在线校准的机理 critic 同时执行候选门控和仿真后瓶颈诊断，指导架构规划器继续搜索。 工作负载抽取器从模型与部署设定生成算子FLOPs、访存量、调用次数和算术强度。 依据阵列数量/尺寸、频率和HBM带宽推导Roofline上限，以仿真观测按算子类型校准有效上限。 先预测候选相对当前最优的延迟，弱候选跳过仿真；评估后生成瓶颈占比和参数变更的反事实预测。 架构规划Agent结合约束、历史及诊断提出下一配置，分别优化prefill和decode。 这是NPU设计探索工具，使用NeuSIM分析型模拟器；架构参数涉及脉动阵列、向量单元、片上容量、HBM及互连带宽，没有报告新芯片流片。 将硬件机理用于可校准的搜索前筛选与搜索后解释，而不只让Agent根据标量奖励生成配置。
digest.experimentsZh: 第4节采用六种LLM规格，每模型16种部署/约束组合，覆盖Llama系列及DeepSeek V2/V3的稠密和MoE配置。 比较BO、CMA-ES、贪心、网格搜索及ChatDSE、LLM-DSE、LLM-Box等方法。 摘要报告在74%的prefill和87.5%的decode设定中达到最好或并列最好延迟，模拟器调用约为有竞争力基线的一半；该比例不是延迟下降百分比。 结果受NeuSIM模型、搜索范围及工作负载抽取准确性影响；门控可能错拒候选。减少模拟器调用不等于总墙钟时间等比例下降，Agent与校准成本需另核实。

papers.title: General Noise Channels and Mid-Circuit Measurements for Pre-Trajectory Sampling with Batched Execution
papers.abstract: Many studies of quantum protocols require fast sampling of large amounts of measurement data from noisy quantum circuits, such as for training machine-learning decoders for quantum error correction. Exact simulation of realistic noise is expensive, while stabilizer-based simulators are fast but approximate, for example through Pauli twirling, which generally alters the output statistics. Pre-trajectory sampling with batched execution (PTSBE) accelerates exact trajectory simulation by sampling noise before state evolution. This method requires the outcome probability of every stochastic event to be independent of the state, which excludes mid-circuit measurements and general Kraus channels. We present a generalization of PTSBE to measurement and Kraus operators without approximation. Each event is partially pre-sampled, while deferred outcomes are drawn during grouped execution via multinomial branching and cached-state reuse. We implement the method for GPUs as an extension of CUDA-Q. On distance-3 topological code memories under amplitude damping, it is up to 24x faster than conventional trajectory sampling in CUDA-Q. On 30-qubit random circuits with mid-circuit measurements, it is up to 83x faster and outperforms the near-Clifford simulator Clifft when more than about 25% of the gates are non-Clifford. With repeated sampling of each final state, its sampling rate per trajectory exceeds that of CUDA-Q by nearly five orders of magnitude. Our method also allows us to compare exact amplitude damping with its Pauli-twirled channel on a surface-code memory, revealing that twirling overestimates the detection rate by 21% and raises the logical error rate of a lookup decoder by 8%. This work makes exact, high-throughput simulation practical for general noisy circuits, from data generation for training decoders to studying measurement-based fault-tolerant protocols under realistic noise.

papers.title: PIPETTE: Prompt Injection Purple-Teaming for Robust LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks. To uncover these vulnerabilities at scale, automated red-teaming methods often leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to generate attacks that achieve high attack success rates (ASR). Model developers use the attacks discovered during internal red-teaming to harden agents through adversarial training before deployment, a collaborative offensive-defensive process known in cybersecurity as purple-teaming. However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training. Specifically, we find that two state-of-the-art RL-based red-teaming methods, RL-Hammer and PISmith, suffer from mode collapse, repeatedly discovering similar attack strategies whose additional successes add no additional robustness improvements to adversarial training. To address this gap, we introduce PIPETTE, a unified prompt injection purple-teaming framework that effectively converts red-teaming discoveries into defender robustness improvements. PIPETTE employs a dictionary learning-based reward that encourages broader coverage of attack strategies during red-teaming. It also integrates an on-policy adversarial training pipeline tailored to IPI defense, enabling agents to resist attacks while completing legitimate user tasks. Extensive evaluations across agentic benchmarks (AgentDojo and ASB) demonstrate that PIPETTE produces defenders that achieve near-zero attack success rates on static attacks and can withstand strong adaptive attacks, while maintaining benign task utility close to that of the undefended baseline.

papers.title: Weighing the Envelope: Component Weight and Arbitration in Envelope-Layer Defenses for a Single LLM Agent
papers.abstract: The envelope layer is the channel through which malicious content enters an LLM agent. Prior work established label and memory effects on multi-agent A2A envelopes, but the weight structure when MCP tools and memory coexist in a single agent remains unclear. Our threat model assumes an attacker pre-plants a malicious tool and poisons long-term memory; a benign user request inadvertently triggers it, and the attacker never enters the conversation. Following GDA Measurement and A/B/C/D, we measure how labels, memory, tool roles, and the backend shape invocation decisions across label-memory conflict, tool roles, robustness, and tool generalization. A tool-side forced-verification label substantially reduces semantic breach, but strong success memory pulls it back; a memory-side downgrade statement returns the outcome to the level of the label alone. The label works through mandatory implementation inspection plus default denial, not length or format; memory authorization wording erodes it with dose, while position and multi-turn pressure do not change the defense direction. Tool roles divide label effects into substitution, suppression, and boundary failure: low penetration is not safety, local leakage is the main residual risk, and a second malicious tool shows the same direction. Envelope labels are not a switch but a measurable, reversible weight constrained by backend and tool role, acting as a soft gate and risk signal within a broader defense rather than a substitute for permissions, sandboxing, or human review.

digest.motivationZh: 攻击者预先植入恶意工具和污染长期记忆后，正常用户请求也可能触发危险调用，工具标签与记忆之间的影响尚不清楚。 只统计是否发生远端穿透，可能漏掉已调用恶意工具、被其他机制拦截或出现本地泄露的情况。 需要区分语义拒绝、调用、拦截与真实外泄，才能判断文字标签是否建立了可靠的边界。 与Agent工具安全和记忆可信度相关，采集命中的memory不是硬件内存，当前芯片研究仅需略读。
digest.methodZh: 在隔离测试床中控制工具标签、记忆授权强度、工具必要性及后端，测量调用决策和安全结果。 按A/B/C/D区分语义拒绝、调用但无外泄、Agent层拦截和真实穿透。 分别改变标签语义/位置、记忆剂量、工具角色和多轮压力，考察组件影响的可逆性。 工具侧强制验证标签与记忆侧降权声明作为实验条件，观察冲突时的结果。 这是Agent执行行为安全测试；Ubuntu容器、MCP工具和后端LLM组成测试床，没有PNM或存内计算硬件设计。 把标签看成受上下文和工具角色影响的软门控，拆分调用意图与最终外泄，避免低穿透率掩盖残余风险。

papers.title: Diffusion Models are Provably Efficient Priors for Sparse Recovery
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have transformed generative modeling through their ability to capture and generate samples from complex data distributions. This success has spurred substantial interest in using pretrained diffusion models as expressive priors for highly ill-posed inverse problems in imaging and sensing. Despite strong empirical performance, theoretical understanding of this approach remains limited: existing guarantees are often asymptotic or entail prohibitive computational costs in the worst case. In this paper, we address this gap by studying sparse recovery from a small number of linear measurements, a classical problem in compressed sensing. We show that, given an accurate diffusion model capturing a sparsity-promoting Bernoulli-Gaussian prior, a likelihood-guided annealed Langevin sampler provably recovers the sparse signal in polynomial time with near-optimal sample complexity for a broad family of random and deterministic sensing matrices. When the signal is indeed drawn from the postulated prior, we further establish total variation guarantees for posterior sampling after a final denoising step. These results lay a theoretical foundation for statistically and computationally efficient inverse solvers with diffusion priors.

papers.title: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
papers.abstract: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.

digest.summaryZh: Z-sight 在VLM自身视觉token空间联合预测未来与动作，以混合Transformer连接视觉语言、前瞻和动作专家，避免视频像素生成。其机器人任务与RTX 4090计时提供可用的VLA负载参考，但主要贡献是模型与生成过程设计。
digest.motivationZh: 视频世界动作模型联合生成未来与动作可辅助控制，却继承了视频生成器的高计算成本。 已有潜空间策略虽避免像素生成，却常使用冻结外部编码器或中间特征对齐，使未来预测脱离VLM当前感知表示。 让未来表示与感知共同演化并直接参与动作生成，可在控制质量与生成开销之间建立更合适的折中。 适合跟踪VLA和世界模型趋势，其动作chunk与联合去噪可作为未来芯片负载；尚不是专用硬件贡献。
digest.methodZh: 在VLM原生视觉token空间联合去噪未来空间token和连续动作，以前瞻专家与动作专家共享条件信息。 视觉语言、前瞻与动作流通过mixture-of-transformers耦合，动作专家读取正在形成的未来表示。 同一视觉编码器的EMA教师提供未来监督，使感知与预测表示在训练中保持对齐。 推理时并行更新未来token和动作，无像素重建或外部目标编码器。 正文第4.5节在单张RTX 4090上计时进程内动作chunk生成；机器人真实评测使用Unitree G1，计时不是机器人传感与通信全链路。 在共同演化的原生视觉空间生成未来，并把其与动作生成放在同一去噪日程，区别于外部冻结特征目标和先生成未来再生成动作。
digest.experimentsZh: 在人类视频和机器人轨迹上训练，评测SIMPLE、LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及六项真实Unitree G1任务；效率测试采用单张RTX 4090。 正文计时比较π0.5、Ψ0、Fast-WAM和GR00T N1.7，并比较相同权重的联合与顺序去噪。 摘要给出SIMPLE成功率81.9%，较最强基线高9.6个百分点；六项G1任务73.3%，高20.0个百分点。表8报告30步chunk中位109.5ms，GR00T N1.7为60.0ms，故并非所有模型中最快。 109.5ms为预热后的进程内模型计算，不等于全机器人端到端；各基线去噪步数和未来生成能力不同，不能仅凭延迟排名推断同质加速。未来流当前未按候选动作进行条件化。

papers.title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
papers.abstract: Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.

digest.summaryZh: UltraTex 采用级联多视图扩散，先生成反照率与着色法线，再结合VLM材质语义和光度表征对齐预测金属度与粗糙度。它改善的是纹理与重光照质量，主要为3D生成应用算法，对当前LLM核心和存储架构方向关联较弱。
digest.motivationZh: 单张参考图像混合了光照、材质和几何因素，同一外观可对应多种金属度与粗糙度，导致PBR材质分解歧义。 只匹配图像外观虽可生成逼真反照率，却容易把光照烘焙进材质或误判金属和粗糙属性，影响重光照。 物理一致材质需要在新光照下维持合理响应，而不是只在输入视角看起来相似。 与VLM辅助生成及多模态表征有关，偏3D内容应用，未涉及AI加速器、低比特或内存层次优化。
digest.methodZh: 使用级联多视图生成把反照率/法线与金属度–粗糙度估计分开，再注入材质语义与受控光照表征监督。 第一阶段联合生成反照率和世界空间着色法线以丰富表面细节。 轻量适配器把VLM隐藏特征转为材质表示token，作为局部语义先验。 光度表征对齐将扩散中间特征拉向受控光照下真实材质渲染，指导金属度与粗糙度。 属于生成模型与训练损失设计，本轮未核实训练芯片、推理速度和内存开销，不能据轻量适配器推断整个系统轻量。 把材质语义锚点与材质–光照响应监督共同用于MR生成，而不只依赖外观匹配。
digest.experimentsZh: 正文第4.2节在152个留出的Objaverse-XL对象上定量评测，并用31位专业3D建模人员进行盲评。 包括LumiTex、TRELLIS.2、Paint-it、DreamMat、Hunyuan3D及若干商业纹理生成方案。 作者报告更好的材质与视觉指标；重光照表3中FID为111.2，对照LumiTex144.4、TRELLIS.2158.4，数值仅对应该表协议。 只适用于当前不透明金属–粗糙度参数化；风格化资产本身可能采用非物理材质，透明、半透明和焦散无法充分表达，未报告本轮可核实的硬件效率收益。
